definition: II. [ מָאַס ] verb Niph`al flow, run (Aramaic id. , but rare and dubious; — secondary form of מסס q. v.); — Imperfect 3 masculine singular וַיִּמָּאֵס Job 7:5 my skin hath hardened and run (i. e. again, afresh; > G Hoffm Du read וַיִּמַּס , Bu וַיִּמָּאס , √ מסס ); 3 masculine plural כְּמוֺ מַיִם יִמָּֽאֲסוּ Ps 58:8 (figurative of annihilation of wicked). [ מַאֲפֶה ] see אפה . מַאֲפֵל , מַאְפֵּלְיָה , see אפל .
